storageUri.description: Where the clone's bytes are, on the resource's primary Representation — the same single home `yield:created` writes to (STORAGE-URI-ONE-HOME).

creator.description: Who made the clone — the emitter, derived at write time. A clone is never job-fulfilling. Absent on events written before derivation existed, whose emitter was their only party.

wasAttributedTo.description: PROV-O wasAttributedTo, derived at write time: the cloner alone. The value the resource view carries.
